# moyiq · Inversiones

> moyiq · Inversiones is the investing section of moyiq (https://moyiq.app), not a separate product. It was formerly a separate site on this host (MOY IQ Invest), until November 2026.

This host (invest.moyiq.app) only serves the market-data APIs used by the moyiq app, the data sources and licenses page, and historical legal pages. Its former pages redirect to the feature page.

- Feature page: https://moyiq.app/inversiones (English: https://moyiq.app/en/investments · German: https://moyiq.app/de/investments)
- Current facts about moyiq and its Inversiones section: https://moyiq.app/llms.txt
- Open Inversiones in the app: https://app.moyiq.app/app/?open=invest-resumen
- Data sources and licenses: https://invest.moyiq.app/datos-y-licencias.html
- Current privacy policy and terms: https://moyiq.app/privacy · https://moyiq.app/terms

Free, in beta. Educational tool: not a broker, does not execute orders, gives no buy or sell recommendations.
